rationale: The 11-feature set improves regression metrics marginally (val nRMSE 0.48270 vs 0.48795; R2_dv 0.4120 vs 0.3848) and even improves fused velocity RMSE at 30 s and beyond.
But it DEGRADES fused dead-reckoning final position error at 14 of 15 feature-set x horizon comparisons on validation (up to +46% at 300 s).
Cause: per-session yaw bias grows with the extra channels, raising heading error by 13-83%, which dominates position error at long horizons.
Per the experiment rules: regression gains that do not translate into trajectory improvement do not justify a feature change.
test_run_purpose: confirm the 6-vs-11 comparison once; the decision does not depend on it
